title: Prime Minister congratulates shooters Sonam Uttam Maskar, Elavenil Valarivan and Vidarsa K Vinod  on winning Silver Medal at the Asian Games
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra has congratulated Sonam Uttam Maskar, Elavenil Valarivan and Vidarsa K Vinod on winning the Silver Medal in the Women’s 10m Air Rifle event at the Asian Games 2026. Shri Modi said that their success would inspire several athletes in the times to come.
Shri Modi posted on X:
Hardwork and teamwork lead to an outstanding result!
Proud of Sonam Uttam Maskar, Elavenil Valarivan and Vidarsa K Vinod for winning the Silver Medal at the Asian Games 2026 in 10m Air Rifle Women’s event.
Their success will inspire several athletes in the coming times: PM @narendramodi
Hardwork and teamwork lead to an outstanding result! Proud of Sonam Uttam Maskar, Elavenil Valarivan and Vidarsa K Vinod for winning the Silver Medal at the Asian Games 2026 in 10m Air Rifle Women’s event.
